request: Fai un programma che decodifica i messaggi ASCII esadecimali.
code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. HEXASCII.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-INPUT       PIC X(256).
       01 WS-OUTPUT      PIC X(128).
       01 WS-DIGITS      PIC X(16) VALUE "0123456789ABCDEF".
       01 WS-LENGTH      BINARY-LONG.
       01 WS-I           BINARY-LONG.
       01 WS-J           BINARY-LONG.
       01 WS-HIGH        BINARY-LONG.
       01 WS-LOW         BINARY-LONG.
       01 WS-CHAR        PIC X.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           DISPLAY "INSERISCI BYTE HEX (ES. 43 49 41 4F):".
           ACCEPT WS-INPUT.
           MOVE FUNCTION UPPER-CASE(
               FUNCTION TRIM(WS-INPUT)) TO WS-INPUT.
           MOVE FUNCTION LENGTH(
               FUNCTION TRIM(WS-INPUT)) TO WS-LENGTH.
           MOVE 1 TO WS-J.
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 2
               UNTIL WS-I > WS-LENGTH
               IF WS-INPUT(WS-I:1) NOT = SPACE
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-HIGH WS-LOW
                   INSPECT WS-DIGITS TALLYING WS-HIGH
                       FOR CHARACTERS BEFORE INITIAL
                       WS-INPUT(WS-I:1)
                   INSPECT WS-DIGITS TALLYING WS-LOW
                       FOR CHARACTERS BEFORE INITIAL
                       WS-INPUT(WS-I + 1:1)
                   IF WS-HIGH > 15 OR WS-LOW > 15
                       DISPLAY "BYTE HEX NON VALIDO"
                       STOP RUN
                   END-IF
                   COMPUTE WS-HIGH = WS-HIGH * 16 + WS-LOW
                   MOVE FUNCTION CHAR(WS-HIGH + 1)
                       TO WS-CHAR
                   MOVE WS-CHAR TO WS-OUTPUT(WS-J:1)
                   ADD 1 TO WS-J
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM.
           DISPLAY "MESSAGGIO: "
               WS-OUTPUT(1:WS-J - 1).
           STOP RUN.
